_v3_build: VoiceBridge V3 integrated build (2026-10-01). Keys under v3/paths/audio_retention/capture_health/g6_regression_test were merged in from voice-bridge-v3/config.json. The AssemblyAI key is NOT here and NOT in this tree: .env is supplied by Don when the candidate runs. Never print, copy or log it.
_note_wake_words: LEGACY ARCHITECTURE (2026-09-02): 'hey keel' wake-word is the OLD design for bouncing across terminal windows. To be REVISITED under the new orchestrator + framework (Don). Do not invest in the current wake-word architecture.

v3._note: V3 engine is persistence + health (src/capture_service.py). The single audio path remains src/capture.py. The interpretation shadow is Stage 2 only: no live authority, no emission, no Stage 3/4/5.

paths._note: Durable full-fidelity transcripts (G6). transcripts/ holds EXACTLY ONE file per finished utterance. data/audio is raw audio, retention-deleted only.

audio_retention._note: D-V3-2. Deletes AUDIO ONLY. Never transcripts, never events, never provenance.

capture_health._note: STEP 3.D. Engine health is surfaced in the status line. Observable silence is a FAULT, never quiet. A latched connection fault does not self-clear; silence does.

g6_regression_test._note: Durable transcript on disk must be byte-identical to STT output. UI previews may shorten; the durable source never does.

interpretation._note: Read by run_v3.py interpret. Stage 2 shadow only: no live authority, no emission, no Stage 3/4/5.

measurement._note: Read by run_v3.py measure. ground_truth_dir is optional; when absent, accuracy metrics are skipped and the multi-claim + confidence-distribution metrics still run.

_deprecated_lanes.rule: A routing destination is a SEAT. These lanes were addressed by model/provider/runtime name, which is exactly the MODEL != SEAT violation. They accept NO new traffic. Existing messages are preserved on disk untouched and may be read for provenance. There is no automatic model -> seat forwarding: no seat name is derived from a model name.
_deprecated_lanes.how_to_address_a_seat: Use the seat mailbox under ...\ai-inbox\<seat> or the _shared broadcast, or route a durable handoff through 06_HANDOFFS\<RECEIVING_SEAT>\.
_deprecated_lanes.reversible: NOT APPLICABLE as of 2026-09-26 - queue_sources and route_buttons were removed entirely (Nico strategy E). Re-adding them would also reintroduce an intake crawl and a routing surface inside VoiceBridge, which the review-surface boundary forbids.

queue._what: Don-facing session queue. Completed work awaiting Don's decision. One ingest, one active item, two explicit actions: ARCHIVE and HANDOFF.
queue._paths: Resolved relative to this product tree by src/completion/paths.py. There is deliberately no absolute path here: the previous absolute paths pointed into the frozen voice-bridge tree, which made that tree a live runtime dependency and split the product across two folders.
queue._no_age_rule: No age-based archival exists. An item leaves the active queue only through Don's ARCHIVE action or a successful HANDOFF.
queue._ingest: python -m src.completion submit <artifact.json>  — the single operation a model uses to return meaningful work.
queue._actions: python -m src.completion archive <id> | handoff <id>  — also available as the ARCHIVE / HANDOFF buttons in the queue panel.
